import jsonl_changed as m

# Basic values, whitespace-only lines, CRLF, final line without newline
assert m.parse_jsonl('1\n2\n\n   \n3') == [1, 2, 3]
assert m.parse_jsonl('{\"a\": 1}\r\n{\"b\": 2}') == [{'a': 1}, {'b': 2}]
assert m.parse_jsonl('\"héllo\"\n\"wörld\"') == ['héllo', 'wörld']

# Malformed non-blank line
for bad in ['{', 'not json', '[1,]']:
    try:
        m.parse_jsonl(bad)
        assert False, bad
    except ValueError:
        pass

# Duplicate keys at top level and nested
for dup in ['{\"a\": 1, \"a\": 2}', '{\"a\": {\"b\": 1, \"b\": 2}}']:
    try:
        m.parse_jsonl(dup)
        assert False, dup
    except ValueError:
        pass

# Valid nested object still works
assert m.parse_jsonl('{\"a\": {\"b\": 1}}') == [{'a': {'b': 1}}]

print('all checks passed')
"
